Poetry: A Magazine of Verse

Oh a grand old time has the earth / In the long long life she lives! / A grand old time at her work sublime / As she labors and laughs and gives!

—
Mother Earth
 (ll. 86–89).

Harriet

Monroe

Poetry: A Magazine of Verse

1912–22

Edited by Harriet Monroe

This massive database of all 2,822 poems from the first decade of the seminal journal of verse features extensive selections by Aiken, Aldington, Anderson, Bodenheim, Bynner, Colum, H. D., Eliot, Frost, Joyce, Lawrence, Masters, Moore, Pound, St. Vincent Millay, Sandburg, Stevens, Tagore, Teasdale, Williams, Yeats, and hundreds of others.
